name: Shadow Labrys
source:
Labrys' Shadow and the main antagonist of the game. Shadow Labrys is sadistic and cruel, enjoying having friends fight each other senselessly. She is also very manipulative, with her abilities of deception and freeform disguise aiding her to control others to follow her plans for the P-1 Grand Prix in order to complete her ulterior motive of becoming free from Labrys. However, as powerful and cunning she is, Shadow Labrys has a rather short temper, often becoming extremely irate at those who try to stop her or indirectly foil her plans. Like other Shadows derived from people, she has the skillful ability to coax her other self to disown her to empower herself.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Shadow_Labrys]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
